macros.name: bibhang
macros.doc: The amount of hanging indentation in the list of references can be redefined via the length command \bibhang.

macros.name: bibnumfmt
macros.doc: The redefined \bibnumfmt command specifies how the reference numbers are to be formatted in the list of references itself.

macros.name: bibpreamble
macros.doc: A preamble appearing after the \bibsection heading may be inserted before the actual list of references by redefining \bibpreamble.

macros.name: bibsep
macros.doc: The vertical spacing between references in the list, whether author–year or numerical, is controlled by the length \bibsep.
